description:
Rush your profiles along with the expected rate 

 Title: Appian BPM Developer 
 Type: Contract or Full time 
 Location: Dublin OH, San Francisco, CA, NJ, CT 
 US Citizen, GC, GC EAD, L2 EAD,  No H1 transfers for training candidates.

H1 for C2C only
 
 Visa copy needed for submission 

 Skills Required

Position 1:

·         Total: 2-4+ years of JAVA/J2EE Genuine experience.

·         Candidates will be evaluated on the technologies that they have worked with and their ability to pick Appian quickly.

·         Candidates must be willing to be in Ohio for initially time period of 3 months minimum to take certification and work on some internal Appian projects to get some hands-on experience in Appian. Hence, they will be deployed on customer projects after 3 months. This time can be decreased by 2 months depending on the adaptability of the candidate.

·         During the training and certification period, they will be in Dublin, OH.

·         After training, for deployment, they have to be open to relocate to any part of the USA.

 Positions 2:

·         Minimum 5 years of Java development experience with any of the BPM tool.

·         Candidates will be evaluated on the technologies that they have worked with and their ability to pick Appian quickly.

·         Candidates must be willing to be in Ohio for initially time period of 3 months minimum to take certification and work on some internal Appian projects to get some hands-on experience in Appian. Hence, they will be deployed on customer projects after 3 months. This time can be decreased by 2 months depending on the adaptability of the candidate.

·         During the training and certification period, they will be in Dublin, OH.

·         After training, for deployment, they have to be open to relocate to any part of the USA.


 BS Degree


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
